paragraphs.text: Mount Tanufel is the tallest peak in Lorwyn , a sacred mountain and the birthplace of the flamekin . Its snowy peaks are home to rimekin . Its Shadowmoor equivalent is Mount Kulrath .
In addition to being the plane's tallest peak, the mountain also stretches a thousand feet below the surface of Lorwyn. It is the birthplace and home of most of the plane's flamekin.

Mount Tanufel's snowy peaks house a settlement of rimekin. The mountain is also where the Wanderwine River has its headwaters, guarded by an elemental called The Source . The Wanderwine is the most merrow -trafficked of Lorwyn's rivers. Some tunnels to the Dark Meanders begin in the bed of the Wanderwine.

The flamekin monastery Ember Fell was also in the region of Mount Tanufel. Architecturally, the monastery was built using sensibilities and geometries unimaginable to other races and made with curved, polished obsidian.

Mount Tanufel was the stage where Ashling 's ritual took place during the Great Aurora . Instead of becoming the vessel for the flamekin flame and Colfenor 's wisdom at once, Ashling decided to take the greater elemental's power for herself and became the Extinguisher.
